changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'EntityUri') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[EntityUri]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [EntityID] [int] NOT NULL, [UriType] [int] NOT NULL, [Format] [varchar](500) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Api_EntityUri] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_EntityUri_Entity') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[EntityUri] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_EntityUri_Entity] FOREIGN KEY([EntityID]) REFERENCES [api].[Entity] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [api].[EntityUri] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_EntityUri_Entity] END
